title: Totally Normal Patch Notes for Totally Normalwatch – April 1, 2025

sections.title: Everything is Normal
sections.description: There is nothing to worry about here. Everything is perfectly normal. The development team has been dealing with an ant problem at their desks for the last few weeks and somehow caused these changes to take place somewhere in the game, but we think we fixed it… maybe. Don’t look at that game mode in the Arcade. We’re not sure where it came from. We’ll try to get it taken down but we’re not able to update that until April 14. Until we do, we’ve put up some challenges to distract you with and you can earn some new cosmetics including the Rainy Ducky Orisa Legendary Skin. Thanks, and you may now resume your totally normal Overwatch 2 experience.

sections.title: Very Normal Hero Updates
sections.description: Perks are disabled as we address an issue with a certain member of the development team yelling “PERKS!” every time they say the word Perks in our meetings.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The Meka Squad are having a rough time against the Gwishin Omnics. So, they are experimenting with new designs to save on materials and rations.

general.text_en: Mech Base Health reduced from 375 to 25.
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Pilot Base Health reduced from 175 to 25.
general.subject: health

changes.text_en: Rate of fire increased by 100%.
Damage reduced by 50%.
Rate of Fire increased by 100%.
Reload Speed increased by 25%.
Damage reduced by 25%.
Press Interact during Self-Destruct to freeze mech in place.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Doomfist decided the best way to win is by punching the opponents… a lot.

changes.text_en: Removed from Primary Fire.
Replaces Hand Cannon as the Primary Fire.
Melee speed increased by 50%.
Melee damage increased by 50%.
Doomfist now lunges toward nearby enemies when he melees.
Melee damage now builds Rocket Punch Charge meter.
Charge meter no longer decays.
Charge time reduced by 50%.
Cooldown decreased by 1 second.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Hazard got tired of rooting people in place, so he thought he'd try knocking them around instead.

changes.text_en: Jagged Wall Knockback increased by 400%.
Jagged Wall Cooldown decreased from 12 to 8 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Everyone got tired of Junker Queen shouting at them and started to ignore her. So, she has gotten selfish and is hoarding her Commanding Shout buffs for herself. She always wants to directly confront anyone who gets hit by Gracie .

changes.text_en: Can no longer be recalled with Secondary Fire.
Junker Queen flies towards Gracie while Secondary Fire is held.
No longer affects allies.
Overhealth increased by 50%.
Bonus Move Speed increased from 30% to 60%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Gunny and Cha-Cha will now lift up their Papa, and whoever is tethered to him.

general.text_en: While airborne and firing both Chainguns at the same time, Mauga is pushed backwards in the direction he is aiming.

changes.text_en: Ammo reduced from 300 to 150.
Reload Speed increased by 15%.
Ammo reduced from 300 to 150.
Reload Speed increased by 15%.
Can now be used during Cage Fight.
Tether is now centered on Mauga and follows him.
Grants Mauga infinite ammo for the duration.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: “I see you glancing at me. You wish to ride me into battle?”

general.text_en: Hanzo can press Interact while near Orisa to ride her into battle, giving Orisa extra movement speed.
general.subject: move_speed

changes.text_en: Javelin Spin now pulls enemies towards Orisa.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Ramattra has elevated the discourse of battle, along with his opponents.

changes.text_en: Now reverses the gravity of all enemies inside.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reinhardt recently saw some street racing anime and has become so obsessed with it that he has learned to drift.

changes.text_en: Cooldown reduced from 7 to 3.5 seconds.
Turn speed increased by 150%.
Charge lasts until you collide with a wall.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: We've been seen everyone's feedback about Chain Hook being so inconsistent over the years, so we hope that throwing three of them at once makes it more reliably lethal.

changes.text_en: Now throws 3 Hooks at once.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Sigma's realized he was not abiding by Newton's third law of motion, so he figures by deflecting the projectiles he blocks with Kinetic Grasp would make him a more psychics law abiding citizen.

changes.text_en: Deflects projectiles instead of absorbing them.
Sigma gains free flight during Kinetic Grasp.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: "Winston Slam!"

changes.text_en: Press Crouch to do a body slam and deal more damage while coming down during Jump Pack.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Hammond has decided to try imitating tumbleweeds and snowballs.

general.text_en: Wrecking Ball gains Overhealth based on his size.
general.subject: health

changes.text_en: Damaging enemies during Roll increases Wrecking Ball's size.
Area of effect increases based on Wrecking Ball's size.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Zarya's enemies have always feared her skills in battle, but now they will run in fear of her reflection too.

changes.text_en: Primary Fire now ricochets off of enemy heroes and the environment.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Bob's arm cannons are in the shop, but he's much more eager to jump into the fray.

changes.text_en: Increased knockback on enemy heroes and briefly reduces their air control.
B.O.B. no longer shoots.
B.O.B. now repeatedly dashes towards the nearest enemy hero and attempts to knock them into the air.
Ultimate Cost reduced by 70%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Bastion made a new friend that happens to be grenade-sized.

changes.text_en: Now spawns an explosive training bot.
Impacts spawns explosive training bots.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Cassidy recently borrowed Hanzo's scatter arrow and figured out how to make new ammunition out of the tech.

changes.text_en: Primary and Secondary Fire both ricochet three times. Ricocheted bullets deal increased damage.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Echo is testing new updates in flight technology, but it seems her other abilities were affected.

changes.text_en: Now fires Sticky Bombs.
Damage reduced from 25 to 14.
Now fires a volley of Tri-Shot projectiles.
Damage increased from 17 to 20.
Flight is now always active.
Activating Flight now causes Echo to dash a short distance.
Now does extra damage to enemies above half health.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Genji can once again spam that annoying emote to heal himself, though there might be negative consequences this time.

general.text_en: Genji once again can occasionally heal himself when requesting healing.
Don't abuse this. You've been warned.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: It’s not a preposterous thought. Hanzo is making a longtime dream come true.

changes.text_en: Fully-charged arrows ricochet twice.
Each arrow ricochets up to 5 times.
While wall climbing, press Reload to attach yourself to the wall.
New Passive
Press Interact while near Orisa to ride her into battle.
While riding, gain 25% damage reduction.
While riding, Orisa controls Hanzo's movement.
While riding, feel 20% cooler.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Junkrat loves explosions so much he decided to become one.

changes.text_en: Can now place up to 5 mines at once.
Maximum damage reduced by 50%.
Max charges increased to 5.
Cooldown reduced to 4 seconds.
Junkrat becomes invisible and untargetable while using Riptire.
Junkrat teleports to Riptire when it explodes.
Junkrat dies if the Riptire is destroyed.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: The cold doesn't bother Mei anymore, but it may bother Mei's enemies.

changes.text_en: Now creates a miniature Blizzard.
Mei can now move during Cryo-Freeze.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Fixed a bug where Moira was classified as a Support Hero and removed any unintended healing. Thank you for your patience as we resolved this seven-year-old issue that has prevented Moira mains from reaching their ultimate damage potential.

general.text_en: No longer has the Support role passive.

changes.text_en: Primary fire no longer heals and instead deals damage.
Healing Orb removed.
Now only deals damage.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Pharah now takes her enemies on a magic rocket ride.

changes.text_en: Direct hits deal increased damage to airborne enemies.
Pull nearby enemies along with Pharah.
Pulls nearby enemies along with Pharah.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Talon got tired of all of the shotguns Reaper was wasting and cut him off their weapon budget until he learns to be more resourceful.

changes.text_en: Reaper can no longer reload and drops his shotguns on the ground when empty.
Dropped shotguns must be picked up to restore ammo.
Movement Speed increased by 25% when out of ammo.
Picking up shotguns increases attack speed for a short duration.
Note: It's hard to melee enemies without your shotguns.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Railgun can now be overcharged to deal more damage. WARNING: Okoton Kelvin-87 Railgun's recoil dampeners not certified for high energy payloads.

changes.text_en: Max charge is now 300%.
Railgun Secondary Fire deals increased damage at above 100% charge.
Railgun Secondary Fire knocks back Sojourn if fired at above 100% charge.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Soldier: 76 being the stubborn old soldier that he is says he doesn't need any help and can still outrun anyone on the battlefield.

general.text_en: Soldier 76 can no longer see allied or enemy health bars. Including his own.
general.subject: health

general.text_en: Passive healing starts faster and heals much faster.

changes.text_en: Running speed increased by 100%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Sombra is exploiting a memory leak, and the only way to shut her down is to press Alt+F4.

changes.text_en: Hacking enemies grants a stacking buff (with a maximum of 10) of movement speed and magazine size.
Stacks are lost on death.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Symmetra is trying out the latest Vishkar fashions on her allies: turrets! She also traded in her gun for a new tankbuster gun that is overcharged.

changes.text_en: Primary Fire now does damage based on target's maximum health.
Secondary Fire charge time reduced.
Turret health Increased by 50%.
Cooldown reduced by 40%.
Projectile speed increased by 100%.
Can now stick to allies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Torbjörn's turret just needs some hammering to reach maximum potential.

changes.text_en: Turret can be Overhealed by Forge Hammer.
When Overhealed, Turret gains increased size, damage, and health.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reinhardt taught Tracer how to charge very short distances, if she stays low enough.

changes.text_en: Blinking while crouching collides with enemies.
Colliding with enemies deals damage and knocks them back.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Venture got tired of working underground. We hope you dig these changes.

general.text_en: If Venture is directly impacted by the projectile from Accretion or a similar ability, Venture is not knocked down and instead consumes the rock and heals themselves.

changes.text_en: Can now fly while burrowed.
Emerge can be charged longer for a stronger effect.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Widowmaker has learned how to catch her prey in her webbing.

changes.text_en: Can now hit enemy heroes, dealing damage and granting Widowmaker Overhealth.
First successful melee attack after hitting a hero with Grappling Hook deals extra damage.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: We’ve heard feedback from Ana players that their teammates ignore them when they call out that they are reloading and go and feed into the enemies anyways. We’re hoping this change makes for good practice for them to start paying more attention to their Support teammates.
Developer Comment: Baptiste discovered some of those old retro platformer video games and now it’s all he ever wants to do.

changes.text_en: Press Crouch while airborne to stomp on enemies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Mace to the face was working so well, so Brigitte thought she'd try her shield too.

changes.text_en: Removed.
New Ability.
Shield Throw will toss Brigitte’s Shield which stuns and bounces between enemies.
During Rally, Shield Throw can hit more enemies.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Illari got tired of allies being out of healing range, she altered her rifle accordingly.

changes.text_en: Primary Fire now heals allies and does not deal damage.
Secondary Fire now damages enemies and does not heal allies.
Secondary Fire range increased by 50%.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: We fixed a bug where allies and enemies were not getting welcomed into orbit as indicated by her Ultimate voice line.

changes.text_en: Knockback increased.
Reverses gravity on all allies and enemies inside.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Kiriko took some swiftness out of her step and put it into attack speed. What could go wrong?

changes.text_en: Swift Step now grants Kiriko overhealth and increased attack speed, but she can no longer choose her target.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Be careful, as you don’t not want Lifeweaver to be a thorn in your side.

changes.text_en: Projectiles now home in on enemies.
Projectiles per shot reduced from 2 to 1.
Rate of fire reduced by 35%.
Projectile speed reduced by 70%.
When enough projectiles hit an enemy, they explode for 160 damage.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: "Can't stop, won't stop."

changes.text_en: Lúcio gains increasing Move, Reload, and Attack Speed while wall-riding.
Buffs from Wall Ride persists for several seconds after touching the ground.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Mercy’s new pistol is just like a loot box… you’ll never know what you’ll get.

changes.text_en: Now fire random projectiles.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: "We are all one within the many, googly irises."

changes.text_en: Now fires sticky googly eyes instead of orbs.
Damage reduced by 25%.
Attack Speed increased by 50%.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue preventing users from using Perks in the 6v6 Maximum 2 Tanks Open Queue Quick Play and will now be played for the remainder of Season 16. Fixed an issue preventing Perks to be selected while Overtime is in progress. Fixed an issue with Zarya’s kit in hero mastery and have reenabled Zarya's Hero Mastery Courses.
